Yamaha Withdraws from Qatar MotoGP Amid Safety Concerns

Yamaha has withdrawn from the Qatar MotoGP event due to safety fears. Despite Yamaha's withdrawal, MotoGP organizers have expressed confidence that the race can proceed. Rider pushback regarding safety concerns has also been noted.
